The Wan configuration referenced by the pinned repository was not published.
configs/benchmarks/turbo_wan22_reconstructed.json is locally reconstructed.
Its tensor geometry was strictly validated against the released checkpoint in
the earlier trained-weight benchmark. Parameter-free settings are not confirmed
by the authors. Random-weight measurements are architecture throughput only.
